# clean-jsdoc-theme

> A clean, customizable documentation theme for JSDoc and TypeDoc. It renders SSR HTML plus a companion Markdown file per page (for LLMs), a fuzzy search index, and optional Pagefind full-text search.

The live documentation is at https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/ . Each page below links to its clean Markdown (`.md`) version. The full docs as a single file: https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/llms-full.txt

## Using the Theme
- [Overview](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/overview/index.md): clean-jsdoc-theme turns a JSDoc or TypeDoc project into a fast, modern,
- [JSDoc Getting Started](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/jsdoc-getting-started/index.md): clean-jsdoc-theme is a JSDoc template. JSDoc does what it always does —
- [TypeDoc Getting Started](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/typedoc-getting-started/index.md): For TypeScript projects, the theme ships as a TypeDoc plugin —
- [Configuration](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/configuration/index.md): Every theme option lives under opts in your jsdoc.json (or, for TypeDoc,
- [Use with an LLM](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/llm-skill/index.md): This theme is built for LLMs — every page ships a companion .md and a
- [Migrating v4 → v5](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/theme/migrate-v4-to-v5/index.md): v5 is a ground-up rewrite: it server-renders every page, emits a companion .md

## Components
- [Overview](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/overview/index.md): The building blocks you reach for when authoring documentation — in prose
- [Playground](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/playground/index.md): In this guide you'll let readers run your examples without leaving the docs. With
- [Embeds](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/embeds/index.md): An embed is a sandboxed <iframe> — a CodePen, a StackBlitz, a live demo,
- [Callouts](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/callouts/index.md): Callouts are typed, colored notice boxes — the kind you use for a tip, a
- [Steps](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/steps/index.md): <steps> renders a vertical, numbered stepper — the kind of "1, 2, 3" walkthrough
- [Tabs](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/tabs/index.md): <tabs> renders a tabbed view — a row of clickable tab buttons over a set of
- [@order](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/order/index.md): @order N is a standalone within-group sort key for any symbol. The inline
- [@category](https://ankdev.me/clean-jsdoc-theme/components/category/index.md): @category puts a symbol's generated page into an explicit sidebar group instead
